title: COD-AB Administrative Boundaries
description: COD-AB (Common Operational Dataset for Administrative Boundaries) is a global, country-by-country collection of administrative boundary layers spanning admin0 through admin4 polygons, boundary lines, and settlement/place points, with P-codes, multilingual names, and centroids for every country. Maintained by UN OCHA for humanitarian coordination and distributed via HDX, it is provided here as GeoParquet and PMTiles with per-country version history alongside a merged global layer.
